description: Find a person's North Node sign (and the South Node opposite), what it grows toward and the old habit it moves away from, in approved plain words, with a link to the free North Node calculator. With birth time and a listed birthplace it adds the exact degree and the house. Use when someone asks "what's my North Node", "my South Node", "my life direction in astrology" or "my karmic path". Uses the site's crossing table and ephemeris (checked against the Swiss Ephemeris), not a memory of dates. Birth dates 1930 to 2031. Without a birth time the result says when the sign changed that day.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.

name: get_north_node
title: North Node sign
